_comment: Edit this file to maintain the loot catalogue. Any item with requires_parse=true is a 'rare item' from the loot rules and needs the 75% best-average parse to SR/roll. Everything not listed here falls under standard SR > MS > OS rules and needs no parse. Names must match Wowhead's exactly — the SR audit classifies by exact name. mage_heal_parse=true means a reserving Arcane mage also has their heal parse checked (Arcane is the healer-mage spec on softres). The rare items below come straight from the loot-rules doc.
